summary: Fire-detection site since at least 1913; the 1948 Aermotor MI-25 tower stands in the Gila Wilderness, with a 1923 log cabin nearby that is on the National Register.

facts.design: Aermotor MI-25 steel K-brace tower with a 14'x14' cab (NHLR says the cab is wooden); Observer's Log Cabin (1923) adjacent

visit.trail_note: Reached on foot by a 12-mile hike to the 10,774-foot peak, per a New Mexico Magazine profile of the lookout's seasonal staffer

events.note: Site used for fire detection since at least 1913, when fires were located with a protractor on top of a stump
Lumber and materials packed in on burros to build a small cab on a tower after fire season
Adjacent log cabin (NHLR: Observer's Log Cabin; Wikipedia: Mogollon Baldy Lookout Cabin), built 1923
A new lookout tower constructed with a cab on top
Current tower constructed on the same location; Aermotor MI-25 (surplus military type) about 30 feet high with a 14x14 cab
Mogollon Baldy Lookout Cabin listed on the National Register of Historic Places; the listing does not include the tower
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register as US 1588, NM 46 on May 22, 2022

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR calls the adjacent building the Observer's Log Cabin and Wikipedia calls it the Mogollon Baldy Lookout Cabin; both date it to 1923 and place it beside the tower. Treated as the same building, though no source says so outright.

notes_for_editor: Tower history (1948 tower, 1924 and 1921 earlier cabs) comes from Forest Lookouts; NHLR confirms the 1948 date and the 30-foot height, and describes the cab as wooden where Forest Lookouts gives no material. The New Mexico Magazine profile carries a page date of Apr. 10, 2024, so staffing is recorded as of that date; Irving's '42 summers' is her own count as reported. The Mogollon Baldy Fire is undated in the sources, so it is not logged as an event. The 1913 fire-detection date comes only from NHLR. Access rules are not stated (access omitted). The Komoot and Facebook pages were not used as sources (the Facebook post repeats NHLR text). Not checked: the NRHP nomination on npgallery and the Wikipedia cabin article's full reference list. Budget limit reached after six page reads and one search.
